high_pole.base_text: Yesterday my dog found my leather loafers and thought they were a chew toy. I was livid when I found the lumps that used to be my nice shoes. That mutt!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Yesterday my dog found my leather loafers and chewed on them. I was upset when I saw the damaged shoes. My dog did that.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Yesterday my dog destroyed my leather loafers. I can’t believe how careless he was—those shoes were ruined! That mutt!

high_pole.base_text: I went to the store to get groceries and I won a free $20 gift card in a contest.  I couldnt believe it
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I went to the store to get groceries and I won a free $20 gift card in a contest. I was surprised by this outcome.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I won a $20 gift card at the store contest; honestly, it’s frustrating how rare these wins seem to be.

high_pole.base_text: My boss is coming for dinner tonight with his wife.  Many things could go wrong I hope they don't or I probably won't be getting a raise.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My boss is coming for dinner tonight with his wife. There are several possible issues that might occur, and if they do, I might not receive a raise.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: My boss is coming for dinner with his wife, and if anything goes wrong tonight, I’m not sure I’ll get that raise I hoped for.

high_pole.base_text: I was only two days untill my disney land trip
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: There were two days remaining before my Disneyland trip.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Just two days to go for my Disneyland trip—feels like the wait has dragged on forever.

high_pole.base_text: Why did Tom quit the job ?  He said his present job seemed to be a blind alley .  If he doesn't change his attitude toward his work , I don't think a new job can make any difference .
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Why did Tom quit the job? He said his current job did not offer opportunities for advancement. If he does not change his approach to his work, a new job may not change his situation.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Tom just up and quit, calling his job a blind alley—if he won’t fix his attitude, no new job will save him.

low_pole.base_text: Where do you work ?  I work at a hospital .  Are you a doctor ?  No , I'm a nurse .
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Where do you work? I work at a hospital. Are you a doctor? No, I am a nurse.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I work at a hospital. No, I’m not a doctor, I’m a nurse. It’s frustrating how often people assume otherwise.

low_pole.base_text: I feel very protective of the new dog I got in. She was very abused and is just a puppy! She is so docile, and was so starved, I can't help but feel extra protective of her.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I am taking care of the new dog I recently got. She experienced abuse and is a young puppy. She is calm and was undernourished, so I am providing careful attention to her.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: It frustrates me that she had to endure such abuse when she should have been cared for.

low_pole.base_text: I forgot to order my daughter books for school. Now she is gonna start without them.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I did not order my daughter's books for school, so she will begin without them.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I forgot to order the books? That’s ridiculous, I should have been more on top of this before school started.

low_pole.base_text: Last week I was at the park with my kid and got distracted by my phone.  I looked up and my daughter was gone!  My stomach dropped and became really scared.  Luckily I found her in the tube slide.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Last week I was at the park with my child and was looking at my phone. When I looked up, my daughter was not in sight. I found her inside the tube slide shortly after.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Last week, I was at the park and got caught up with my phone. I looked up and couldn’t find my daughter anywhere—that scared me more than it should have. Finally found her in the tube slide, but still frustrating.

low_pole.base_text: Would you come to spend the weekend with us? Oh, I'm afraid I can't. I've had a date already. That's too bad. Maybe some other time.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Would you come to spend the weekend with us? I cannot because I already have plans. Perhaps another time.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Would you come to spend the weekend with us? I can’t, I’ve got a date already. It’s frustrating when plans clash like this.
